notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for both a nonempty one-dimension result and the required empty-set result when an object class has no available dimensions; each invocation is reported through HLAreportServiceInvocation. The API behavior maps to §10.21. The Lab-exported §10.20.6 crosswalk is the preceding service's reference chart; use the existing RL-423 source-backed correction without changing the Lab export. Report delivery is checked only for the asserted fields and is not a claim of complete §11.5 or §11.5.1 coverage. Federation setup reuses the existing federation execution API contract. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM (including the typed object class and its configured dimension), standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. Provider-private headers, registries, routing, file sinks, names, and diagnostics are outside this contract.
